canonical_observer_adapter.actual: GatewayToolAdapter.call dispatches mapped filesystem/process calls via dispatchToolCall; shell_execute/image_preview/project_inspect have direct implementations. No unified pre-intent/post-outcome observer or public invocation UUID exists.
canonical_observer_adapter.required: Exactly-once observer after authorization/scope and before side-effect dispatch, outcome callback before transport handling. Owner acceptance still required.

dispatcher_dispatchToolCall.signature: dispatchToolCall(name: string, args: any, options: DispatchToolOptions = {}): Promise<ServerResult>
dispatcher_dispatchToolCall.actual: Gateway adapter calls with isRemote=true. server.ts separately implements stdio dispatch. No pre-intent callback; legacy history records outcomes for eligible local calls.

process_correlation_keys.actual: Gateway adapter session_id is decimal PID; offsets/length pass into legacy line API. Direct runtime generation is direct-in-process:<bootNonce>. Legacy optional child engine has random runtime UUID. No durable per-execution UUID/range-completeness correlation contract.

shared_resource_accounting_status.actual: Final 1.0.10 production and packaged files exclude the proposed resource-accounting module. Do not claim shared context job/DB accounting is integrated.

observer_exclusion_hook.actual: Legacy EXCLUDED_TOOLS contains get_recent_tool_calls and track_ui_event only; no canonical exclusion seam.

readiness_and_shutdown.actual: Device bootstrap acquires runtime ownership. Gateway uses direct adapter and advertises runtime_ready=true with boot nonce; no eager child initialize. Update shuts down before helper. Shutdown closes gateway/legacy engine and releases RuntimeOwner. Optional legacy engine assertReady returns DEVICE_NOT_READY; child close/transport close have 3000 ms timeout each.

gateway_device_channel_direct.actual: Authenticated handleToolCall calls options.adapter.call directly, then sends result/error only if socket/device/connection_epoch still match. Delivery failure does not request another execution. request_id is transport correlation, not a durable execution UUID.

test_baseline_pass.provenance: Inherited final-release evidence, not rerun by Phase 1

runtime_node_version.note: Feature floor is not an assertion that 1.0.10 required >=22.13.0.

release_commit.initial_dirty_state: Only staged new specs/002-device-local-context files; src unchanged relative to release commit.
release_commit.invalidation_rule: Material observer/dispatcher/process/resource/lifecycle/schema changes require refreshed handoff and dependent tests.
